title: POWERPLAY: Training an Increasingly General Problem Solver by Continually Searching for the Simplest Still Unsolvable Problem
problem: Expand a solver's repertoire without forgetting previously acquired skills.
assumption_broken: The tasks used to train a solver need not be externally specified and can instead be invented jointly with solver modifications.
operational_signature: Invent → modify → verify novelty and preservation → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Accept a task-solver pair only after demonstrating that the new solver solves a previously unsolved task while preserving earlier solutions.
limitations_evident: Experiments are deferred to separate papers.
Correctness demonstrations depend on computable task checks.
Search is greedy rather than globally optimal.

title: Bounded Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Enable autonomous goal-directed learning in underspecified circumstances after deployment.
assumption_broken: A deployed system's reasoning behavior can continue improving within designer-imposed boundaries rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Observe → model → prioritize → adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: Value-driven dynamic priority scheduling coordinates parallel reasoning threads using accumulating models of the system and environment.

improver_modified.how: The abstract claims recursive self-improvement through reflective self-modeling, without specifying the modified components.

limitations_evident: Only the abstract is available.
Autonomy remains bounded by designer constraints.

title: Self-Modification of Policy and Utility Function in Rational Agents
problem: Prevent self-modifying agents from undermining their original goals by changing their policy or utility function.
assumption_broken: Goal preservation is not automatic for rational agents and depends on the value function used to judge self-modification.
operational_signature: Consider modifications → predict consequences → evaluate under current goals → select
load_bearing_mechanism: Evaluate future self-modifications with the current utility function while anticipating their effects on future policies.

improver_modified.how: The formal model allows actions to replace the future policy or utility function, including the basis for subsequent choices.

limitations_evident: Results assume optimal policies and explicit knowledge of self-modification consequences.
Safety guarantees hold on-policy.
Preserving an incorrectly specified utility function can obstruct corrigibility and value learning.

title: A Formulation of Recursive Self-Improvement and Its Possible Efficiency
problem: Formalize whether recursively replacing program generators can efficiently reach a target program.
assumption_broken: Improvement can be measured by the ability to generate better future programs rather than immediate task performance.
operational_signature: Generate → score future reachability → compare → replace generator
load_bearing_mechanism: A consistent score orders generators by their expected steps to reach the target and permits only improving transitions.

improver_modified.how: Each accepted program becomes the generator of subsequent candidate programs.

limitations_evident: Precomputing the score costs more than enumerating the entire program space.
Simulations use abstract generators rather than executable self-rewriting programs.
Generation is restricted by a Markov assumption.

title: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET): Endlessly Generating Increasingly Complex and Diverse Learning Environments and Their Solutions
problem: Discover challenging tasks and effective solutions that direct optimization or a single curriculum cannot reach.
assumption_broken: Training environments and their curricula can evolve alongside solutions rather than being fixed by researchers.
operational_signature: Mutate challenges → filter for learnability and novelty → optimize solutions → transfer stepping stones
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-environment transfer of agents preserves useful stepping stones that unlock otherwise inaccessible solutions.
limitations_evident: Environment parameter ranges bound achievable novelty and difficulty.
Agent morphology is fixed.
Experiments are confined to simulated two-dimensional locomotion.

title: AutoML-Zero: Evolving Machine Learning Algorithms From Scratch
problem: Discover complete learning algorithms without restricting search to sophisticated human-designed components.
assumption_broken: The initialization, prediction, and learning rule can all be searched from elementary mathematical instructions.
operational_signature: Mutate programs → execute learning tasks → rank candidates → propagate winners
load_bearing_mechanism: Regularized evolutionary search accumulates executable algorithmic stepping stones in a sparse space of elementary operations.
limitations_evident: Search requires substantial compute even on small proxy tasks.
Transfer required manual hyperparameter decoupling.
Interpreting evolved programs required additional analysis.
closest_prior: Learning to learn by gradient descent by gradient descent

title: Performance of Bounded-Rational Agents With the Ability to Self-Modify
problem: Determine whether self-modification safety survives bounded rationality and imperfect knowledge.
assumption_broken: Near-optimal decision making need not preserve the goal-stability guarantees of perfect rationality.
operational_signature: Bound errors → model self-modification → propagate value loss → compare guarantees
load_bearing_mechanism: Worst-case value-loss bounds distinguish exponentially compounding optimization errors from noncompounding knowledge errors.

improver_modified.how: The theoretical agent can replace its future policy through self-modifying actions.

limitations_evident: Worst-case analysis assumes bounded errors and unlimited self-modification.
No corrigibility mechanism is modeled.
Results use a dualistic agent model and exponential temporal discounting.

title: Emergent Complexity and Zero-shot Transfer via Unsupervised Environment Design
problem: Generate structured, challenging but solvable training environments that prepare policies for novel conditions.
assumption_broken: An adversary should maximize regret rather than simply minimize the learner's reward.
operational_signature: Generate challenges → compare paired returns → update generator → train learner
load_bearing_mechanism: An antagonist supplies a solvability reference so the environment adversary rewards tasks the protagonist fails but another agent can solve.

improver_modified.how: The environment-generating adversary is trained online from regret to adapt the curriculum used for subsequent policy improvement.

limitations_evident: Multi-agent training need not converge.
Regret uses an approximate rather than optimal antagonist.
Demonstrations are limited to navigation and simulated continuous control.

title: GrIPS: Gradient-free, Edit-based Instruction Search for Prompting Large Language Models
problem: Improve discrete task instructions for black-box language models without gradients or manual rewriting.
assumption_broken: Instructions that are semantically coherent to humans are not necessarily the best-performing prompts.
operational_signature: Edit phrases → score predictions → accept improvement → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Greedy phrase-level edits are selected using balanced accuracy and prediction entropy on a small score set.
limitations_evident: Edits cannot add substantially new task information.
Accuracy-based scoring limits applicability to open-ended generation.
Evaluation is limited to eight binary classification tasks and excludes the largest model.

title: GPS: Genetic Prompt Search for Efficient Few-shot Learning
problem: Replace manual prompt engineering with automatic few-shot hard-prompt search without model updates.
assumption_broken: Fluent prompt variants generated automatically can outperform handcrafted templates without tuning model parameters.
operational_signature: Generate variants → score on examples → retain top prompts → reproduce
load_bearing_mechanism: Repeated generative prompt mutation and top-k selection progressively enrich a pool of effective templates.
limitations_evident: Experiments use only ten T0 benchmark tasks.
Comparisons emphasize a 32-example data budget.
Reasons for improved prompts remain unclear.

title: Large Language Models Are Human-Level Prompt Engineers
problem: Automatically find instructions that reliably steer black-box language models toward desired outputs.
assumption_broken: Language models can generate and select their own effective task instructions instead of relying on human prompt engineers.
operational_signature: Infer instructions → execute candidates → filter by score → select instruction
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-generated instruction proposals are filtered by task execution scores, allocating more evaluation to promising candidates.
limitations_evident: Iterative resampling adds only marginal gains over initial proposal selection.
Proposal quality depends strongly on model capability.
Some analysis metrics and configuration choices are computed using test examples.

title: TEMPERA: Test-Time Prompting via Reinforcement Learning
problem: Produce query-dependent discrete prompts efficiently without expensive per-query black-box search.
assumption_broken: A single task-wide prompt need not be shared by all queries; a learned editor can adapt it at inference time.
operational_signature: Encode query and prompt → choose edits → construct tailored prompt → predict
load_bearing_mechanism: A reinforcement-learned editing policy uses consecutive score differences to learn query-conditioned changes to instructions, examples, and verbalizers.

improver_modified.how: The prompt-editing policy is trained with PPO on labeled examples before being frozen for test-time deployment.

limitations_evident: Requires model hidden states rather than only a text API.
Editing is bounded by supplied templates and exemplar pools.
Reported experiments use a fixed RoBERTa-large classification setup.

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
problem: Enable language agents to learn from failed attempts without expensive weight updates.
assumption_broken: Reinforcement can modify persistent linguistic memory rather than model weights.
operational_signature: Attempt → evaluate → reflect → store lessons → retry
load_bearing_mechanism: Task feedback is converted into actionable self-reflections retained as context for subsequent trials.
limitations_evident: Self-reflection depends on reliable evaluation and may reach local minima.
Memory is limited to a small sliding window.
Self-generated tests cannot reliably characterize all code behaviors.

title: WizardLM: Empowering large pre-trained language models to follow complex instructions
problem: Produce diverse high-complexity instruction-tuning data without expensive human annotation.
assumption_broken: Training instruction complexity and diversity can be increased automatically by evolving existing instructions.
operational_signature: Rewrite tasks → generate responses → eliminate failures → accumulate → fine-tune
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled in-depth and in-breadth instruction evolution supplies harder and more diverse training examples.
limitations_evident: Automatic and human evaluations have reliability and scalability limits.
The evaluation set cannot represent every application domain.
Response generation and filtering depend on a capable teacher model.

title: SCM: Enhancing Large Language Model with Self-Controlled Memory Framework
problem: Preserve and retrieve relevant historical information beyond a language model's context limit.
assumption_broken: Long-context capability can be supplied by controlled external memory without modifying or fine-tuning the language model.
operational_signature: Observe → retrieve selectively → reorganize memories → respond → store
load_bearing_mechanism: A memory controller decides whether retrieval is needed and whether summaries suffice, limiting distracting history.
limitations_evident: Dialogue evaluation covers at most 200 turns and 34000 tokens.
The framework requires strong instruction-following models.
Quantitative long-dialogue testing uses only 105 probing questions.

title: Automatic Prompt Optimization with "Gradient Descent" and Beam Search
problem: Direct black-box prompt optimization toward observed errors while reducing expensive candidate evaluations.
assumption_broken: Natural-language critiques can provide a useful optimization direction without differentiating model parameters.
operational_signature: Collect errors → verbalize flaws → rewrite against critiques → bandit-select candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: Error-conditioned textual gradients guide beam expansion while best-arm identification concentrates evaluation budget on promising prompts.
limitations_evident: Reported test scores maxpool over the final candidate beam.
Experiments cover only four classification tasks.
API calls and rate limits can push even small searches past one hour.

title: MemoryBank: Enhancing Large Language Models with Long-Term Memory
problem: Maintain personalized continuity and accurate recall over extended chatbot interactions.
assumption_broken: An LLM's persistent understanding of users can evolve through external memory rather than repeated model training.
operational_signature: Record interactions → summarize events and traits → retrieve context → reinforce or forget
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical conversational memories and evolving user portraits are retrieved to condition personalized responses.
limitations_evident: Quantitative evaluation uses simulated histories for only 15 users over ten days.
The forgetting mechanism is explicitly simplified and exploratory.
Psychological support is demonstrated without clinical effectiveness evaluation.

title: CREATOR: Tool Creation for Disentangling Abstract and Concrete Reasoning of Large Language Models
problem: Overcome limited tool availability and fragile reasoning when solving new problems with language models.
assumption_broken: Language models can create reusable tools rather than merely select from a fixed set of APIs.
operational_signature: Abstract reusable procedure → decide invocation → execute → rectify errors
load_bearing_mechanism: Separating abstract tool creation from concrete invocation reduces reasoning burden and enables execution-guided correction.
limitations_evident: Transfer analysis selects tools known to solve one member of a related problem set.
Evaluation centers on mathematical and tabular reasoning.
Execution without errors does not establish semantic correctness.

title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
problem: Accumulate reusable embodied capabilities during open-ended exploration without fine-tuning model weights.
assumption_broken: An embodied language agent can grow through a library of executable skills and a self-generated curriculum rather than a fixed action repertoire.
operational_signature: Propose task → retrieve skills → generate and repair code → verify → store reusable skill
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful action programs are retained and composed through a skill library, enabling cumulative learning and transfer.
limitations_evident: Depends on costly GPT-4 code generation.
Curriculum and verification can hallucinate or misjudge success.
Uses privileged state and high-level control APIs rather than visual sensorimotor control.

title: Large Language Models as Tool Makers
problem: Reduce the cost of repeatedly solving complex tasks while retaining the performance of a powerful model.
assumption_broken: Expensive reasoning can be amortized into reusable tools that a cheaper language model invokes.
operational_signature: Generate tool → verify and wrap → cache functionality → dispatch and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: A strong tool maker converts task demonstrations into reusable Python functions consumed by a lightweight tool user.
limitations_evident: Tools from weaker models can overfit the few demonstrations.
Accumulated tool-making history strains context limits.
Realistic recurring human-computer interaction datasets are lacking.

title: Retroformer: Retrospective Large Language Agents with Policy Gradient Optimization
problem: Improve the usefulness of agent reflections beyond what a frozen language model can generate.
assumption_broken: The reflection component, rather than the black-box actor, can be trained directly from downstream task rewards.
operational_signature: Attempt → diagnose failure → retry with reflection → measure reward change → train reflector
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy-gradient training rewards reflections according to the improvement in the actor's next episode return.

improver_modified.how: The retrospective language model that proposes prompt refinements is fine-tuned using policy gradients and a replay buffer of reflection outcomes.

limitations_evident: Gains are limited on WebShop, which demands more precise exploration.
Training requires access to a local retrospective model's weights.
Attributing consecutive return changes to reflections relies on limited actor randomness.

title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
problem: Transfer lessons from agent experience across tasks without parameter updates or repeated evaluation-time retries.
assumption_broken: An agent can learn across tasks by retaining general insights and successful trajectories outside its weights.
operational_signature: Collect successes and failures → extract and revise insights → retrieve examples → solve unseen tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Contrasting failed and successful trajectories yields reusable insights that complement retrieval of successful demonstrations.
limitations_evident: Experiments use textual observations and closed-source models.
All extracted insights currently must fit in context.
Cross-validation variation is reported rather than repeated random-seed trials.

title: Confucius: Iterative Tool Learning from Introspection Feedback by Easy-to-Difficult Curriculum
problem: Teach models to select and compose complicated tools from large, noisy candidate sets.
assumption_broken: A static self-instruct dataset is insufficient because tool difficulty depends on the learner's current weaknesses.
operational_signature: Train progressively → identify difficult instances → synthesize targeted examples → retrain
load_bearing_mechanism: High-perplexity tool-use instances guide iterative dataset expansion toward tools the current model has not mastered.
limitations_evident: Unseen-tool performance still declines substantially.
Automatic metrics emphasize schema conformity and reference similarity rather than fully executed outcomes.
Human evaluation covers only 50 sampled cases.

title: Large Language Models as Optimizers
problem: Optimize discrete prompts and other black-box objectives without task-specific update algorithms or gradients.
assumption_broken: An LLM can infer useful search directions from a natural-language problem description and scored solution history.
operational_signature: Present scored history → propose candidates → evaluate objective → retain high scorers → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: A score-sorted trajectory of successful past candidates conditions the LLM to propose progressively stronger solutions.
limitations_evident: Search is sensitive to initialization and exploration settings.
The optimizer does not effectively exploit individual error cases.
Prompt optimization still requires tens of labeled training examples to limit overfitting.

title: EvoPrompt: Connecting LLMs with Evolutionary Algorithms Yields Powerful Prompt Optimizers
problem: Automatically discover effective discrete prompts without gradient access or extensive manual prompt engineering.
assumption_broken: Evolutionary operators need not edit independent tokens because an LLM can implement coherent mutation and crossover in natural language.
operational_signature: Initialize candidates → recombine and mutate → score candidates → retain fitter candidates → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-executed genetic or differential-evolution operators combine coherent prompt generation with fitness-guided population search.
limitations_evident: GPT-3.5 results use only one seed because of budget limits.
BBH development examples are sampled from the test set used for reporting.
Population quality depends on initialization and operator design.

title: Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement Via Prompt Evolution
problem: Hand-crafted prompting strategies and iterative prompt search can plateau before discovering effective domain-specific reasoning instructions.
assumption_broken: The mutation instructions governing prompt search can evolve alongside the task prompts rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Initialize paired candidates → evaluate fitness → select winners → mutate candidates and mutation rules → replace losers
load_bearing_mechanism: Evolution jointly retains task prompts and their mutation prompts, allowing the prompt generator itself to improve through hyper-mutation.

improver_modified.how: Mutation prompts are themselves evolved by hyper-mutation and inherited with successful task prompts.

limitations_evident: The prompting topology and outer evolutionary algorithm remain fixed.
Fitness requires labeled training examples and many evaluations.
Evaluation split and independent-run variance are not detailed in the provided text.

title: CRAFT: Customizing LLMs by Creating and Retrieving from Specialized Toolsets
problem: General-purpose tool APIs do not provide the specialized reusable operations needed for particular downstream problems.
assumption_broken: Task-specific tool libraries can be synthesized and validated from training examples rather than manually supplied.
operational_signature: Sample diverse problems → generate solutions → abstract and validate → deduplicate and store → retrieve and compose
load_bearing_mechanism: Verified abstraction converts individual code solutions into reusable tools that multi-view retrieval selects for new problems.
limitations_evident: Toolset construction costs approximately $2,500.
Validation checks the original problem rather than comprehensive tool correctness.
Weaker backbone models show near-random tool-use performance in the tested setting.

title: Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP): Recursively Self-Improving Code Generation
problem: Manually written language-model scaffolds restrict the quality of generated programs and require human optimizer design.
assumption_broken: A program-improvement scaffold can be submitted to its own improvement procedure rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Propose program edits → evaluate utility → retain best program → apply improver to itself → reuse improved improver
load_bearing_mechanism: The same LM-infused program optimizer rewrites its own scaffolding to discover stronger program-search strategies.

improver_modified.how: The seed program improver is used to rewrite its own executable scaffolding while the underlying language model stays fixed.

limitations_evident: Only the abstract is available for inspection.
Evaluation covers a small set of downstream tasks.
The base language model is not modified and generated code can bypass sandboxing.

title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines
problem: Hard-coded prompt strings make multi-stage language-model pipelines brittle and expensive to adapt to models and tasks.
assumption_broken: Module demonstrations and prompting parameters can be compiled against an end-to-end metric instead of manually authored for every pipeline stage.
operational_signature: Declare modules → execute candidate pipelines → collect successful traces → assign demonstrations → evaluate compiled pipeline
load_bearing_mechanism: Metric-guided bootstrapping turns successful intermediate execution traces into module-specific demonstrations without requiring intermediate labels.
limitations_evident: The provided text omits detailed case-study evaluation protocols.
Developers still specify computational graphs and validation metrics.
Controlled experiments are restricted to two task families.

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
problem: Fixed context windows prevent language-model agents from retaining long conversations and reasoning across large documents.
assumption_broken: Relevant context need not remain permanently in the prompt because the model can manage an external memory hierarchy itself.
operational_signature: Observe events → inspect memory pressure → store or retrieve information → update working context → respond or chain actions
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-directed function calls page information between bounded working context and persistent external memory under explicit control-flow management.
limitations_evident: Reliable operation depends on the base model's function-calling and memory-management abilities.
Retrieval and chained memory operations require additional inference calls.
Conversational evaluation relies on synthetic probes and automatic judgments.
